audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls the lane EVEN at 6/10, but the content level chart gives Kled five of seven stages and the prose says 'you cannot fight him straight'.
audit.why: Emerald+ 44.12% over 34 games. That is a losing lane, and the page's own prose agrees; only the EVEN/6-10 label disagrees.
audit.corrected: This should read unfavoured, nearer 7/10, matching the chart and the 44% win rate.

audit.why: The chart's shape is right: Level 1 to Aurora before Bear Trap on a Rope is up, Kled through 3 to 5, Aurora at 6 on the rift, Kled again once his items land. It matches the prose in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole Level 6 plan rests on a fabricated mechanic: the page says standing in Between Worlds makes Aurora 'untargetable to enemies outside the rift', so Chaaaaaaaarge!!! whiffs. Between Worlds grants no untargetability — it damages, slows, and lets Aurora teleport across the zone.
audit.why: Riot's text for Between Worlds: 'releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.' Nothing about untargetability.
audit.corrected: The rift beats his engage because it slows him inside it and because you can teleport across it as he commits — not because he cannot target you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jousting is never mentioned. It is a two-part dash — he can recast to dash back through his initial target — so leaping away from the first dash walks you into the second.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.'
audit.corrected: Do not spend Across the Veil on his first Jousting dash: hold it for the return dash, which is the half that catches you.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere. The decisive one is that Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 while Across the Veil is 22s — he gets two grabs per escape.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap 11s, Jousting 13s, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140s at rank 1; your W is 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer spells his Q 'Beartrap on a Rope' throughout. Riot's name is 'Bear Trap on a Rope'. The content layer writes his ult 'Chaaaaaaaarge!!' with two exclamation marks; Riot's name has three.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap on a Rope; Chaaaaaaaarge!!!

notes: The fabricated 'Between Worlds makes you untargetable' mechanic is load-bearing here — it is the entire stated reason Level 6 is Aurora's stage, in spikes[1], wants.you[1], mid, late and whys[4]. I rewrote those to the real reason (the rift slows him inside it and you can teleport across it as he commits), and kept Level 6 as Aurora's stage, which the slow and the cross still support. Champion-wide: 61 occurrences of the same false claim across champ-data/content/aurora.js.
